stopped.description: Nothing runs until you start it again.

interrupted.title: A deployment did not finish
interrupted.description: Nobody can say for certain what this service is running. Backups, restores, renames, deletion and changes to its ports and domains are refused until a deployment succeeds.

restore_failed.title: The previous version could not be put back
restore_failed.description: A deployment failed and bringing the previous version back failed too. Backups, restores, renames, deletion and changes to its ports and domains are refused until a deployment succeeds.

flags.pendingHint: Saved settings the running version does not have yet. They arrive with the next deploy. Click to see them.
flags.silentHint: Its tasks are running, but nothing answered on its port at the last deployment. A started container does not prove the app works.
